Full closure plus induction proves all finite sizes, not mere small-n extrapolation; verifier additionally independently cross-checks generic Hintikka recurrence on 204 representatives and short words. value.rationale: The entire natural hereditary family of two-sided Ferrers/chain graphs is classified by a rank-three first-order invariant. Exact 2833 classes, finite complete testing collection and sharp smallest representative size 21 address substantive, naturally motivated invariants instead of a selected arbitrary parameter slice. The transition system is constructive and reusable for all rank-three first-order statements over this signature; independent proof of numeric count and small-model optimality is nontrivial.
